content: BGG XMLAPI2 /thing?stats=1 statistics/ratings block schema: <average value="X.XX"/>, <averageweight value="X.XX"/>, <ranks><rank type="subtype" id="1" name="boardgame" friendlyname="Board Game Rank" value="N" bayesaverage="..."/> plus additional <rank type="family" .../> entries for subdomain ranks (strategygames, familygames, etc). The overall rank is distinguished by name="boardgame" (id=1), not by type (type=subtype is shared). Unranked games/expansions render value="Not Ranked" (a literal string, not numeric) for both value and bayesaverage attributes on that rank element.
